project.name: otlp4j-core
project.description: The public contract surface of the otlp4j gateway: component identity and kind, pipeline identity, signal descriptors, consumers and delivery context, delivery results, the neutral policy vocabulary, and the component lifecycle and factory contracts. JPMS module dev.nthings.otlp4j.core - no transport, no third-party wire or resilience library. This module ships the full component, consumer, pipeline, policy, result, and signal contract set the rest of the gateway builds on.
